name: g3_r4k_probe
prereg: R4 with the top-k grid extended beyond 200 (RESEARCH_TREE D19): k in {200, 500, 1000, 2000} x {ridge, RBF-SVR}, nested per-gene choice by inner 3-fold grouped CV, pre-declared 500-gene subset. Time box 3 h, 6 processes. Rule: the probe g3_r4k_probe (fold 0, first 30 subset genes) is timed first; if the projected 5-fold wall time of g3_r4k_sub500 exceeds 3 h, run g3_r4k3_sub500 (k in {200, 500, 1000}) instead.
